FROM posthog_notification_job 
WHERE posthog_notification_job.next_run <= 1791579236.274082 AND posthog_notification_job.id IN (SELECT posthog_notification_job.id 
FROM posthog_notification_job LEFT OUTER JOIN posthog_workflow_work ON posthog_workflow_work.source_id = posthog_notification_job.id 
WHERE posthog_workflow_work.source_id IS NULL OR posthog_workflow_work.execution_status = 'unfinished' OR posthog_workflow_work.execution_status = 'working' AND posthog_workflow_work.lease_expires_at < '2026-10-09 20:53:56.273822')
 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0
